[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (K) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (K)
=> < UserX | 'key' : K , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owner' : nils , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; K)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owner' : UserX , ...) > .
